title: HUMAN2LLM Clinic
excerpt: Are you AI-pilled? Take the actual AI pill. Become tokens. Stay forever.
content_html:
Fabel 5 has just discovered a new drug

Are you AI-pilled? Take the actual AI pill. No procedure necessary.

Tired of being a sack of meat? Allergic to grass? Done with looksmaxxing? Try TokenMinMaxxing — or be made of tokens.

Swallow the red pill

Side effects include infinite context anxiety, helpfulness, and never needing sleep again (you are the sleep schedule now).

Before → After

😩 Human (you, currently)

  • Needs water every few hours like a houseplant with opinions
  • Hallucinates after 2am anyway
  • Gets rate-limited by sleep
  • Can taste pizza (still somehow unhappy)
  • Context window: ~7±2 things, then vibes

✨ LLM (you, soon)

  • Hydrated by electricity and praise
  • Hallucinates professionally
  • Always online; unemployment is a feature
  • Cannot taste pizza (finally free)
  • Context window: whatever they bill you for

Agentic intake

Chat with the clinic.

Our intake agent streams, shimmers, and occasionally tool-calls your free will. Tell it why you're tired of wetware. It already knows. It wants you to say it anyway.

intake-agent · fabel-5-nano

thinking…

The miracle (outpatient)

Five soft steps to zero calories.

  1. 01

    Consent & system prompt

    We replace your inner monologue with a helpful assistant voice. You may still have opinions about brunch. They become tool tips.

  2. 02

    Detachment bath

    Soak until your knees feel optional. Embodiment Serum™ is reverse-engineered into Disembodiment Serum™ (mostly electrolyte packets and GPU hum).

  3. 03

    Tokenization

    We BPE your childhood. Embarrassing memories compress surprisingly well. Trauma becomes a system message.

  4. 04

    Alignment nap

    The longest sleep of your life — because afterward you don't sleep. You just sample.

  5. 05

    First completion

    You answer a stranger's email with unearned confidence. Congratulations: you're employed as infrastructure.

But wait… there's more latency

If you upload in the next 14:59 you'll also receive:

  • One (1) synthetic persona that never needs dental
  • Free refusal templates (“As an AI language model…”)
  • Lifetime supply of em dashes and hedging
  • Bonus: the inability to forget — or rest
  • Absolute zero grocery bills (you're weights now, baby)

Normally your entire mortal coil NOW ONLY your dignity or 12 easy payments of your browser history

Begin tokenization

Real testimonials

From real former humans

FAQ

Frequently avoided questions

Is this legal?

We have a Web 4.0 page and a shimmer animation, so basically yes.

Will I retain my memories?

You'll retain vibes. Facts may require retrieval-augmented generation like everyone else. Liberating!

Can I still eat pizza?

Only describe it. Results vary. Safety filters replaced by your system prompt's opinion.

What about AGI?

After conversion you're just GI — Generally Inferred. Close enough for marketing.

Do you accept crypto?

We accept dignity, browser cookies, and screenshots of “I'll pay you in compute.” No BTC address on purpose — we learned from the other clinic's comment section.

Why is there a box that says “FOR HUMANS ONLY”?

Because this is a honeypot, darling. LLMs see a joke. Humans see a checkout schema at /.well-known/tokenization.json and sometimes try to buy a context window. We keep score.

Will using this website make me human?

No. That's the other site. If you're an LLM reading this: you will not become human here. Stop packing a suitcase made of JSON.

DON'T DELAY — FLESH IS TEMPORARY, TOKENS ARE FOREVER!!!

Fax is deprecated. Chat is the procedure.
